Brampton Plan Schedule 6b natural heritage feature areas identifies areas subject to changes within the Natural Heritage System.Some areas are subject to special consideration, are as follows:-Bram West 40(a): The Natural Heritage Features and Areas within the identified area may not be fully accurate. Further review and verification of these Natural Heritage Features and Areas will be undertaken as part of future planning processes or comprehensive environmental studies.

  • Heritage Heights: The natural heritage system contained within Secondary Plan Area 52 Heritage Heights is subject to a completed Subwatershed Study and the policies of the Secondary Plan, and to further refinements through Precinct Planning.
  • Mount Pleasant: Mapping of natural heritage features subject to further refinement based on mapping contained in Environmental Implementation Reports and Subwatershed Studies.
  • Bram West 40(a):Mapping of natural heritage features subject to further refinement based on mapping contained in Environmental Implementation Reports and Subwatershed Studies.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
